jobs.description:
Technology, Innovation and Challenge? That's Music to Your Ears!Are you technically skilled, enjoy troubleshooting and getting machines up and running again, and thrive in an environment where innovation is constantly evolving? Then we have an exciting opportunity for you!In Hasselt, we are looking for an experienced Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system.You will join a modern, high-tech production environment where innovation is at the heart of everything we do. You will work with an extensive and high-performance range of machinery and have the opportunity to contribute to the continuous improvement and optimisation of the technical operations.⚙️ What will you be doing?
• As a Maintenance Technician, you will ensure that the entire machinery fleet continues to operate at its best.
• You identify and efficiently resolve mechanical and electrical faults.
• You carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• You actively contribute ideas for technical improvements and optimisations.
• You help prevent breakdowns by identifying potential issues at an early stage.
• You work closely with your colleagues in the technical department and the Engineering Manager.
• You contribute to a safe, high-quality and efficient production environment.
🛠️ Who are we looking for?We are looking for someone with strong technical skills who enjoys taking responsibility. 
• You have at least 3 years of experience as a Maintenance Technician in a production environment.
• You have solid knowledge of both mechanical and electrical systems.
• You have strong technical insight and a solution-oriented mindset.
• You are independent, proactive and hands-on.
• You remain calm under pressure when technical issues arise.
• You work accurately, flexibly and well as part of a team.
• You have a good command of English.
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift system (early/late shifts).

Our client specializes in industrial drive technology and is known for its technical expertise, high-quality service, and family-oriented working environment. To strengthen their workshop team, they are looking for a hands-on technician with a passion for mechanics.As a Mechanical technician, you will be responsible for repairing, overhauling, and maintaining a wide range of industrial components and equipment.Your tasks include:
• Assemble, disassemble, and overhaul industrial gearboxes and mechanical drive components according to technical drawings
• Mount, align, and replace high-precision roller and ball bearings, including inductive heating and tolerance checks
• Connect, test, and fault-find AC and DC motors, including checking coils and stator windings for insulation resistance and faults
• Diagnosing and troubleshooting mechanical faults
• Performing maintenance and repair work
• Carrying out technical inspections and functional tests
• Maintaining a clean, organized, and safe workshop
• Collaborating closely with fellow technicians and the workshop supervisor

• You have strong mechanical knowledge or relevant experience
• Experience as a technician, mechanic, or maintenance technician is a major advantage
• You enjoy practical, hands-on work
• Knowladge over AC/DC gearboxes
• You can speak English or Dutch
• You have a valid category B driving licence

Van Heyghen Staal is a modern steel service center located in Evergem, in the Ghent canal zone near the Port of Ghent. Founded in 1981, the company processes around 250,000 tons of steel plates per year on its cut-to-length and slitting lines, and supplies hot-rolled sheets, plates and slit coils to clients across Europe in a wide range of sectors. Its strong position in the European market is built on quality, innovation, service and just-in-time delivery. To support its automated production lines and upcoming projects, Van Heyghen Staal is looking for a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics.

Jobomschrijving

Job descriptionAs a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics, you will start with an extensive learning program in which you will get to know our activities and automated lines in detail. You will build expertise in technology, processes and concepts. After this onboarding period, you can grow within Maintenance, Operations or Projects, depending on your interests and talents.

• Managing spare parts and helping plan preventive and corrective maintenance.
• Analyzing breakdowns and developing sustainable solutions.
• Actively contributing to investment and innovation projects.
• Coaching and supporting the technical team so that production runs continuously and optimally.
• Taking part in a rotation to coordinate Saturday maintenance approximately every 6 weeks.
• Contributing to digitalization and automation projects.
• Supporting energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.
• Monitoring and improving technical safety procedures.
• Involvement in a production line renewal project.

Profile

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Electromechanics.
• Preferably at least 3 years of experience, but motivated starters are also welcome (junior profile with some experience).
• Broad technical interest: mechanics, pneumatics, electronics, hydraulics and electricity.
• Hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented.
• Knowledge of automation, drive technology and technical drawing is a plus.
• Good command of English is essential; additional languages

As a Mechanical Machine Builder in Genk, you are responsible for assembling machines according to mechanical drawings. 
• You initiate assembly activities and ensure the smooth execution of the production process.
• Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues are also part of your responsibilities, working closely with the technical department.
• You support the team by maintaining a strong focus on quality, safety, and environmental management systems.
• Working with measuring equipment and having knowledge of fit systems and bearing arrangements is essential to ensure accurate and correct assemblies.
You have a secondary technical degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience in the sector. 
• You are experienced in machine assembly and are able to accurately read and interpret mechanical drawings.
• You also have knowledge of fit systems and bearing arrangements, which is essential for accurate assembly and the commissioning of installations.
• You are able to identify and resolve technical issues using a practical, hands-on approach.
• Experience working with measuring equipment is a plus.
• Basic knowledge of relevant software is required.
• You communicate fluently in English, verbally and in writing.

Our client is a family-owned industrial company specialized in solutions for electric motors, gearmotors, pumps, and fans. They are currently looking for an experienced Motor Winder to join their workshop team in Belgium.You will work in a technical production environment where precision, quality, and craftsmanship are key. A strong onboarding program is provided, allowing you time to adapt to the trade.Your responsibilities include:
• Winding of electric motors (AC and DC)
• Insulation and protection of windings
• Checking coils (inductance, continuity, static and dynamic balance)
• Working based on technical drawings and winding sheets
• Determining electrical component properties from plans and existing windings
• Producing different types of motors, mainly in small series
• Working with copper wires of various thicknesses
• Operating conventionally controlled workshop machines
We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled professional:
• Minimum 2 years of experience in motor winding or similar technical work
• Experience with AC and DC motors
• Basic knowledge of electrical engineering
• Ability to read and follow technical drawings
• Precise, independent, and eager to learn
• Good command of English
• European nationality
• Driving licence B is a plus
• Flexible and reliable attitude👉 If you recognize yourself in this profile, you are the ideal candidate for this position.

Responsibilities

• Lead and coach a multidisciplinary team of approximately 10 remote engineers and order administration specialists.
• Manage the end-to-end customer journey from project delivery and service operations to financial follow-up.
• Ensure high service quality, customer satisfaction, and strict compliance with SLA requirements.
• Oversee incident management and escalations to maintain service continuity for business-critical customer environments.
• Monitor financial performance including budgets, OPEX, and team capacity planning.
• Drive process improvements across service delivery, project execution, and billing workflows.
• Maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across sales, operations, finance, and external vendors.

Requirements

• You possess 5+ years of experience in people management within technical or telecommunications environments.
• You bring strong expertise in PABX, Voice, or Unified Communications solutions.
• You have experience with platforms such as Avaya, Unify, 3CX, or Alcatel.
• You're experienced in managing SLA-driven service organizations and operational planning.
• You have a proven track record with budget ownership and financial follow-up.
• You bring the ability to lead mature expert teams through organizational change and digital transformation.
• You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent through professional experience.
• You possess an analytical mindset with the ability to balance operational detail with strategic overview.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications in Avaya or Unify.
• Knowledge of ITIL Foundation and ITSM processes or tooling.
• Experience with fixed connectivity solutions.
• Background in managed services or systems integration environments.
• Basic conversational knowledge of French.

Responsibilities

• Conduct autonomous studies and functional analyses to translate business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Develop business process models and system documentation using UML and BPMN methodologies.
• Partner with Product Owners and delivery teams to refine backlogs and ensure high-quality solution design.
• Design scalable and maintainable functional solutions aligned with the overall application landscape and architectural constraints.
• Coordinate with development teams during the delivery lifecycle, including functional testing and user acceptance validation.
• Manage the functional resolution of incidents and problems while performing root cause analysis for continuous improvement.

Requirements

• You have extensive experience in business and functional analysis within a complex application landscape.
• You bring a strong understanding of solution design, including APIs, data flows, and integrations.
• You possess proficiency in modeling with UML and BPMN using tools like Sparx Enterprise Architect.
• You're experienced in Agile environments and proficient with delivery tools like SharePoint, Confluence, and Jira.
• You have a solid understanding of Application Lifecycle Management, including incident and problem management.
• You bring technical knowledge of relational databases and the ability to write SQL queries.
• You possess strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured approach and attention to detail.
• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to bridge business and technical teams.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Oracle or MS SQL Server.
• Trilingual proficiency in English, French, and Dutch.

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

For a company in the Tielt region, active in the food industry, we are looking for a motivated and reliable Packaging Operator.

Your responsibilities:

• Operating and monitoring packaging machines and equipment.

• Preparing products for the packaging process.

• You like working with vegetables

• Checking the quality of packaged products.

• Monitoring the packaging and production process.

• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems to the supervisor.

• Keeping the workplace clean and organized.

• Following all safety, hygiene, and quality procedures.

 

 

Your profile:

• Experience in production or machine operation is an advantage.

• Willingness to work during the day

• Reliable, accurate and motivated.

• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Good work ethic and a responsible attitude.

• Besides Polish or Romanian of other language,  you also  have a good knowledge of English

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

Do you have a passion for logistics? 

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

jobs.occupation: Internship - Digitalization & AI for Wiper Blade Testing
jobs.description:
Your challenge

Join our wiper blade test department and help us make our testing processes smarter, more standardized and data-driven. You will work on practical digitalization and AI solutions together with our test engineers.

Your main tasks

• Test specification standardization
• Compare existing wiper blade test specifications and identify opportunities for complexity reduction.
• Standardize test descriptions and required information.
• Develop an AI-based solution to easily compare specifications and highlight differences.
• AI for test reports
• Develop an AI solution to search and analyze historical test reports.
• Investigate how the quality and structure of existing data can be improved.
• Create a standardized template for future test reports to enable effective AI-based analysis.
• Digitalization of test equipment
• Update the test equipment inventory, including equipment locations.
• Support the preparation and entry of equipment data into the new laboratory management system planned for 2027.
• Wiper arm digitalization & 3D scanning
• Create an inventory of available wiper arms and link them to the existing wiper arm library.
• Support the digitalization of wiper arms using 3D scanning.

• Bachelor or Master student with a technical/engineering background, for example mechanical, automotive, electromechanical or industrial engineering.
• A strong interest in digitalization and Artificial Intelligence.
• An analytical and structured way of working.
• Motivation to work with technical specifications, test reports and engineering data.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with test engineers.
• Good written and spoken English, as you will work with technical specifications, reports and colleagues in an international environment.

jobs.occupation: Internship in the field of Lean Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Depending on your study program the internship may contain the following main points:

• Support the design of new production machines and processes.
• Participation in Bosch Production System projects: continuous improvement work on existing production and/or logistic processes the fields of Safety, Quality, Cost & Delivery.
• Standardization and improvement of production and/or logistics processes.
• Definition & implementation of lean standards: value stream planning, standardized work, pull production, leveling, quick changeover, …
• I4.0 and digitalization.
Preferred start date:February - March

You must be enrolled as a student.

• Language: good knowledge of English is required. German and possibly Dutch is a plus.
• Fields of study: mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, production engineering, technical business economics.
• Completed basic study period.
• Good knowledge of MS-Office.
• You are able to communicate efficient & effective, you can work on your own and as a team player.
• Responsible, independent and reliable worker.
• Intercultural interest and understanding.
• 
An internship will be successful if you are inquisitive, active and ask for work.

The main condition is that you are a European citizen and if not, you can only do an internship through a European exchange program.

  QUALIFICATIONS 
   
•   Level of Education: Bachelor's Degree in Administration, university degree or equivalent by experience

•   Languages: Proficient in English (verbal and written); other languages are a benefit

  COMPETENCIES – PERSONAL CAPABILITIES
